title: Ori Dual-TPR Findings Envelope V1
description: Structural schema for the dual-source TPR findings envelope. This schema is OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible (the codex CLI passes it via --output-schema, which OpenAI accepts only as a strict subset of JSON Schema). Additional invariants that cannot be expressed in the OpenAI subset (regex patterns, length limits, conditional requirements) live in envelope_invariants.py and are enforced by validate-envelope.py / parse-codex.py / parse-gemini.py at parse time. See BUG-08-003 for the rationale.

status.description: complete = clean termination; failed_partial = reviewer ran but did not finish all analysis. Missing field or any other value is treated as 'failed' by the orchestrator.

expanded_beyond_packet.description: REQUIRED. The reviewer must explicitly state whether it expanded its investigation beyond the orchestrator's starting packet.

expansion_reason.description: Required (and must be non-empty) when expanded_beyond_packet is true. One sentence explaining what additional surface was explored and why. Code-level invariant enforced in envelope_invariants.py.

ordinal.description: 1-indexed insertion order. Code-level invariant: ordinal >= 1 enforced in envelope_invariants.py.

location.description: Repo-relative path:line. No absolute paths, no leading ./, no line ranges. Dotfiles like .gitignore:3 ARE allowed; only the leading two-character ./ prefix is rejected. Code-level invariant: regex ^(?!/)(?!\./)[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+:[0-9]+$ enforced in envelope_invariants.py.

title.description: Imperative voice, sentence case, no markdown, no trailing punctuation. Code-level invariant: maxLength 200 enforced in envelope_invariants.py. Style is enforced by prompt template.

url.description: Source URL. Code-level invariant: format=uri enforced in envelope_invariants.py.

citations.description: Source URLs (gemini's google_web_search results, codex prior-art references, etc.). Tool-agnostic name (renamed from search_citations per Codex Round 1 feedback).

no_findings.description: Explicit 'reviewed cleanly with zero actionable findings' flag. Without this, an empty findings array could mean 'crashed before finding anything'. Code-level invariant: when no_findings is true, findings array must be empty; enforced in envelope_invariants.py.
